title: Describing a Damaged Landscape: *-va/-ve*
grammar: Recap: *-va/-ve* states, and verbs of lying and standing
goal: I can describe a damaged landscape with a *-va/-ve* participle (*kiszáradva fekszik*, *lecsapolva*).
I can talk about soil and drained land (*elszikesedés*, *tájseb*, *mocsárlecsapolás*).
I can say what a landscape looks like after drainage.
